visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young men are seated at a wooden table inside a brightly lit McDonald's restaurant. The central man, with curly hair and sunglasses, looks intently at a white paper receipt while his friends sit beside him in a casual indoor setting. The background reveals a clean, modern fast-food interior with warm yellow lighting and wooden furniture. (2) A man in a blue and white cap is suddenly shown in a close-up, his mouth agape in exaggerated shock while holding a green soda cup. The editing then rapidly cycles through shots of a Big Mac burger, fries, and chicken nuggets on the table, often accompanied by long receipts. (3) The camera zooms in on another friend wearing a yellow cap who is also screaming with wide-eyed disbelief and hands raised. High-contrast text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen, listing the prices of different food items in New Taiwan Dollars to highlight the expense. (4) The three men lean in together, looking directly at the camera while screaming in unison with humorous, shocked expressions. One of them holds a very long paper receipt that trails off the bottom of the frame, visually emphasizing the high total cost of their meal.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track begins with an upbeat, high-tempo pop song featuring a male vocal lead. A male voice speaks with high pitch and fast delivery, sounding enthusiastic and surprised. The overall acoustic atmosphere is filled with the high energy of the music. (2) A sharp, piercing scream sound effect, characteristic of meme-style editing, triggers a new phase. Multiple male voices begin yelling at extremely high volume and arousal levels, overlapping with the persistent rhythmic beat of the background music and bright electronic synthesizers. (3) Frequent audio cuts introduce new bursts of high-pitched, slightly distorted vocal screams that act as rhythmic punctuation for the visuals. The pitch variability is extreme, moving from conversational surprise to full-throated shouting. The BGM maintains a steady, driving tempo. (4) The phase culminates in a collective, sustained high-frequency scream from all three speakers, reaching maximum loudness and spectral brightness. The music swells momentarily before a hard cut, leaving a sense of high-energy comedic shock. No background environmental noise is detectable over the loud production.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to comically highlight the extremely high prices of McDonald's menu items in Switzerland compared to Taiwan. It uses a fast-paced 'meme' editing style, exaggerated vocal reactions, and high-energy music to entertain the audience while providing travel-related price trivia.
